feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. The controller is the iteration 0 controller unchanged, because iteration 0 (63.0) remains the best score and iteration 1's gain increase on a narrower track scored lower (53.7). So the race will test mass alone, as you intended. Iteration 0 showed all 60 trials ending off track with max_error 0.062 to 0.066 m, about 1.0 line-loss event per run on the s-bend and slalom, and steering_oscillation of only 0.13 to 0.15. The robot therefore drifts after one line loss rather than jittering, and I had no need to change the gains to make this geometry work. Iteration 3 (y = 0.07 m, scored 61.5) showed that forward offset does not remove the line loss, so y = 0.05 m is kept. Iteration 2 changed mass together with span, footprint and body length, so its mass effect cannot be separated and should not be read as a verdict on mass. Please read the next race by these branches: if line losses fall below about 0.5 per run on the s-bend and slalom without a score drop, mass is helping, and a sensor-footprint test is next. If line losses stay at 1.0 per run with max_error at or above 0.06 m, mass alone is not the fix, and the next change should be body_length. If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.2 with the lower mass, the robot is over-turning, so mass should return toward 0.7 kg rather than adding gain.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events fall below 0.5 per run on the s-bend and slalom and the score is at or above 63, keep mass 0.5 kg and try sensor_size 0.008 m (footprints 8 mm) to sharpen the edge reading at the sharpest bends, since iteration 0 at 12 mm had 1.0 line losses per run.

If line losses stay at 1.0 per run with max_error still at or above 0.06 m, keep mass 0.5 kg and try body_length 0.12 m alone, since iteration 2's body change was confounded with span and footprint and cannot be attributed.

If steering_oscillation rises above about 0.2 with the lower mass, return mass to 0.7 kg, since iteration 0 (0.7 kg) showed steering_oscillation of only 0.13 to 0.15 and the robot is then over-turning.
